name: Locked Out
source:
After an exhausting day, all Sallie wanted was to get back home.

The freezing winter night seems to become even harsher when she finally reaches her apartment and realizes that her keys are missing. Locked out and shivering in the cold, she thought her luck has run out – until her new neighbor appears and kindly invites her into his apartment.

A warm escape from the cold, or the beginning of something unexpected?
